result.one_liner: Open-source WordPress ecommerce plugin with REST API for managing products, orders, and customers.

evidence.quote: OAuth Authentication: WooCommerce follows the spec for simple OAuth 1.0a authentication. API Key Authentication: Pre-generated keys can be used to authenticate use of the REST API endpoints.
WooCommerce is a free, open-source commerce platform for WordPress. API credentials can be self-served directly from your WooCommerce admin panel without requiring any external service or payment.
WooCommerce 2.6+ is fully integrated with the WordPress REST API, allowing WC data to be created, read, updated, and deleted using requests in JSON format.
To generate your WooCommerce API credentials, log in to your WordPress dashboard. New keys can be generated either through the WordPress admin interface or auto-generated through an endpoint.

result.notes: WooCommerce REST API is fully self-serve with credentials generated in admin panel. Core API is REST (v3); GraphQL support available via optional WooGraphQL extension. API breadth estimated at medium range based on common endpoints (products, orders, customers, variations). No official MCP server.
